user.title: Atom Home
user.description: Adds the Atom Home panel to the sidebar. Devices are discovered from Home Assistant; pick what to show in the panel's Setup screen.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Atom Home is already set up.

missing_helpers.title: Atom Home: helpers are missing
missing_helpers.description: Home Assistant has no {helpers}. Without `input_boolean.alarm_ringing` and `input_text.alarm_ringing` (length 255) an alarm rings, but the panel shows no banner and no Stop button; without `input_text.atom_light_sleep` (length 255) the light sheet does not show «turns off at…» and the timer cannot be cancelled there. Create them in Settings → Devices & services → Helpers with exactly these entity ids, then restart Home Assistant.

short_helpers.title: Atom Home: a text helper is too short
short_helpers.description: The maximum length of {helpers} is under 255. Home Assistant refuses a longer value, so the panel shows old lamp timers or no alarm banner. Open the helper in Settings → Devices & services → Helpers, set the maximum length to 255, then restart Home Assistant.
